description: run_pdf_extraction.py called without --company or --fiscal-year — metadata missing from all downstream outputs
mitigation: Document in contract; upstream caller must pass args; audit tool detects absence

description: document_record.json or document_inventory.json absent in input_dir — company/fiscal_year fall back to empty
mitigation: _resolve_company_year() logs warning; audit tool flags; path inference as last resort

description: All candidates have empty company (e.g. CSV/Table also failed) — backfill produces nothing
mitigation: Backfill only applies when at least one non-empty source exists; empty company is logged

description: accepted_candidate_inputs.csv has empty company — propagates to indicator_preparation_database
--override-empty-company-from-cli used with multi-document input without --single-document-mode — mixes companies
mitigation: Explicit ValueError raised if multiple document_ids detected without single_document_mode

description: Directory-name guessing (heuristic) returns wrong company for non-ESGFinalCorpus paths
mitigation: Heuristic only used as fallback (level 3); always logs warning; audit tool detects

description: fiscal_year accidentally set to year found in evidence text (content year)
mitigation: fiscal_year injected from CLI at document_record construction; evidence records get additive field; never modified downstream

description: Visual candidates from a different document share same document_id — backfill applies wrong company
mitigation: Only backfills when company is empty; correct company must come from extraction; document_id collision is upstream error

description: normalizer uses fiscal_year as year fallback — could be confused with year_raw
mitigation: Normalizer writes to normalized_year field; fiscal_year field is read-only in normalizer; verified in tests

description: New metadata fields break existing output contract validators
mitigation: All injections are additive (at end of records); existing required fields preserved; backward compat tests cover this
